capabilities: Create and refresh CR/SR/INC ticket notes from ServiceNow
Search, filter, translate, and date-filter work notes
Build work logs and four-state To-Do boards
Maintain a configurable ticket dashboard with saved columns and filters
Import Gemini meeting minutes and Google Drive documents
disambiguation: Not a ServiceNow or Atlassian client for editing remote records by default; it writes ticket Markdown into the Vault and only makes separately authorized, human-confirmed Jira changes.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.11.5+); mobile unsupported due to desktop OAuth callback and Electron/Node APIs. No developer backend or telemetry. Organization status guides, SLA rules, and AI templates require a separately supplied work guide pack. Translation has a local monthly character budget (default 400,000) tracked in translation-usage.json. Uninstalling does not delete ticket notes, documents, work logs, or To-Dos.
problem: ServiceNow ticket metadata, work notes, documents, and follow-up tasks normally live outside Obsidian, so they cannot be searched, linked, or tracked alongside daily notes.
summary: ServiceNow ticket manager that creates and refreshes CR/SR/INC notes, work logs, To-Do boards, dashboards, and optional Jira/Confluence, Google Drive, and AI Wiki workflows.
